video_title: NBA Stars Tyrese Maxey, Trey Murphy, JJJ & More Join The Show at PLYRS UNTD | Numbers On The Board

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on playing through injuries and his role on the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I was dedicated to make sure that I showed the world and to myself that I was capable
quotes.quote: The year before this year, we had a terrible year. All of us were hurt from the beginning of the season. I played through injuries, I probably shouldn't have been playing, but I'm like, man, somebody, we got to go out here and try. This last year, I was dedicated to make sure that I showed the world and to myself that I was capable of leading the team to the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his role and sacrifice on the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the day, I want to win. I have played with a lot of different people
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, I want to win. I have played with a lot of different people and a lot of different roles. So at the end of the day, I am going to have to change some of the things, but because of the dynamic of our team, we don't expect Process to play 70 games. If he does, we will be good. We don't expect Process to play 70 games, so that's how you balance it out.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on the recruitment process of Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I remember, I don't know if he was a free agent two years ago or last year
quotes.quote: I remember, I don't know if he was a free agent two years ago or last year, and you know, we work out in the morning. So I text, I'm like, man, give me Jalen Brunson, I'm about to mess with him real quick, just on some funny stuff. I hit him like, yo, you know, you're always welcome to come to Philly if you want to, you know what I'm saying, before he resigned back to the Lakers. We knew he was going back to the Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his sleeve and the team's culture
quotes.excerpt: I've never worn a sleeve my entire life. The homies like, yo, it's year six, bro
quotes.quote: I've never worn a sleeve my entire life. The homies like, yo, it's year six, bro, we going, come on, bro, you get nothing. I'm like, dog, you know good and well if I get out there to sleeve, two time taking it off. They like, bro, just try it. So I tried it, first day of media day. I just have it on, it looked cool, the pictures or whatever. Me and Joel have it on. Then I work out in it, and I'm like, okay, hold on, this feel all right.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on the team's reaction to the Jermaine trade
quotes.excerpt: That's after we traded Jermaine. We were just like, damn, bro, like the vibes were just sad
quotes.quote: That's after we traded Jermaine. We were just like, damn, bro, like the vibes were just sad. And I was like, eff it, Process, come on, we wearing a headband today, me, Process, VJ. Put on, we going, we played the Suns, everybody put a headband on, have some fun, and we won.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his shooting development and role
quotes.excerpt: When James and them was here, and I got to shoot like, I didn't have to shoot as many
quotes.quote: When James and them was here, and I got to shoot like, I didn't have to shoot as many rush threes at the end of the clock and stuff. I shot 43% from three, two years in a row. So just put that in perspective of how I think I can shoot. I think I'm a really good shooter. I feel like I'm up there, man. I feel like I'm up there, man.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his mentality and role on the team
quotes.excerpt: My mentality doesn't change no matter what the roster looks like. I'm glad to be on the roster
quotes.quote: My mentality doesn't change no matter what the roster looks like. I'm glad to be on the roster. I'm glad to be, you know, I guess, media glorified as a cornerstone or, you know, pivotal piece or whatever. But honestly, like, my goal doesn't change. I go in here trying to make sure I'm the best possibly prepared as I can be to be one of the best players in the league.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his decision to stay in the draft
quotes.excerpt: I was 50/50. Real talk. And the reason why was one, Duke, not only prestigious program
quotes.quote: I was 50/50. Real talk. And the reason why was one, Duke, not only prestigious program, but mainly I wanted the experience of, because I didn't end college the way I wanted. I had a shoulder injury. It took basketball away from me. So I didn't end college how I wanted. And I knew if I would have went to Duke, I'm saying it right now, we would have won national championship. But with that, I was battling the emotional side versus the logical side.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on the team's defensive mentality
quotes.excerpt: Grit and grind is always going to be a part of it. It's a mentality
quotes.quote: Grit and grind is always going to be a part of it. It's a mentality. And that's not only in the culture of the team, but that's in the culture of the city. Like, I mean, if you drove around Memphis, you can like, see the people are the same way. And that's what we want to instill, like from that era, like you just said. So for us, it's, we want to be the team that nobody wants to play.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his development and role on the team
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to put myself in a position to where that player is me. Obviously
quotes.quote: I'm trying to put myself in a position to where that player is me. Obviously, you know, like, you're going to be putting situations like that, kind of involuntarily, but at the same time, voluntarily, if you put yourself in a situation, you're, you're just preparing for that. And then at the same time, I'm also preparing like, if I'm not the focal point, too. Like, you got to still work on stuff. Like, you can't just work on your ISO bag the whole time. Work on stuff like catching shoot threes, work on stuff as, you know, cutting, stuff like that, playing with split decisions.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his focus during the off-season
quotes.excerpt: Most of it is like ball handling, making sure and shot creation. I think it's like
quotes.quote: Most of it is like ball handling, making sure and shot creation. I think it's like, you have to be able to get the ball to somebody to get a shot. Obviously, you can have all the best plays in the world and stuff like that, but at the end of the day, you got to have people that can execute it.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: There's been like three things. This is my driving, like specifically slowing down, so I can make
quotes.quote: There's been like three things. This is my driving, like specifically slowing down, so I can make better decisions, you know, get the mid-range shots, post-ups, and then obviously just working on my body. I end of the year like 205, I'm right now I'm at 225, so, and I feel really good. Like, this is good 225 right now.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on the new practice facility
quotes.excerpt: Man, a lot of work to bring this to light. Me myself personally, you know, retired 2019
quotes.quote: Man, a lot of work to bring this to light. Me myself personally, you know, retired 2019, did the front office for a minute, you know, management side with the Warriors. That's still family. Then when Andre Iguodala got the job as executive director with the player association, came over with him, you know, just give the service back to the guys. And so this is what's been keeping me busy.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy on his transition from player to front office
quotes.excerpt: I tell people, obviously hindsight's 20/20, but the injury was the best thing that ever happened to me
quotes.quote: I tell people, obviously hindsight's 20/20, but the injury was the best thing that ever happened to me. Wow. You know what I'm saying? And that's that's really just wisdom talking to you now. Like I don't, you know, I hung the shoes up, don't play, but just going through that at 21, being a pillar of a franchise, a core piece, wanting to be a Hall of Famer, All-Star, superstar, and then, you know, having those dreams kind of shattered because of physical limitations. Um, but it was it was about, you know, salvaging and and making the most of the cards that's dealt, dealt, you know, and that's that's life, right? It's like, yo, things are going to happen, adversity hit me at 21, I was, you know, I was grateful for that adversity because when I bumped into more adversity down the line, whether I was cut, waived, traded, it's just a part of the game, part of the business, because my mindset was already set to to be able to handle that.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his upcoming music release
quotes.excerpt: I got one coming whenever I want to do it. It's literally done.
quotes.quote: I've done music for a while, I've had like a set of albums. I got one coming whenever I want to do it. It's literally done, it's on my phone. I haven't had time to go to the studio in a long time.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on balancing basketball and outside interests
quotes.excerpt: All my outlets ended up turning into like work because I ended up wanting to do them full go.
quotes.quote: As a hooper, you got to have outlets, but I feel like all my outlets ended up turning into like work because I ended up wanting to do them full go.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his favorite rappers
quotes.excerpt: I like Ken Carson, I like Osama, I like Net, I like Cardi, I like everything they do.
quotes.quote: I like Ken Carson, I like Osama, I like Net, I like Cardi, I like everything they do. I like Don Toliver a lot right now.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his pre-game music choices
quotes.excerpt: I listen to a lot of V's. I listen to a lot of V's.
quotes.quote: I listen to a lot of V's. I listen to a lot of V's.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his music release strategy
quotes.excerpt: I rarely listen to Ganger now because I listen to all unreleased.
quotes.quote: I rarely listen to Ganger now because I listen to all unreleased. So like I be using captions on Instagram as his lyrics.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the Utah Jazz's mindset
quotes.excerpt: I think we're just one track minded, one goal, championship, put it together, build every day.
quotes.quote: I think we're just one track minded, one goal, championship, put it together, build every day. I try to just tell them little stuff because I'm a little bit older than them. A lot of them are younger, just stay even-killed, don't get too high, too low.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his veteran mentors
quotes.excerpt: Mark Gasol, Mike, even Dillon. Dillon, it was Dillon's second year, but I feel like he was an OG.
quotes.quote: Mark Gasol, Mike, even Dillon. Dillon, it was Dillon's second year, but I feel like he was an OG to me kind of. I had a lot of dudes on that team. I had Shelvin Mack, Marshon Brooks, Garrett Temple, Kyle Anderson. I had a lot of vets, man.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the business side of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: My dad playing probably helped and my dad coaching because he gave me insight on little stuff.
quotes.quote: My dad playing probably helped and my dad coaching because he gave me insight on little stuff growing up if I had questions. So I think I understood that it wasn't personal, you're an asset.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on his role in the Utah Jazz offense
quotes.excerpt: I don't usually see a big who's slower. So like even if I am at the five, they probably will rotate that.
quotes.quote: I don't usually see a big who's slower. So like even if I am at the five, they probably will rotate that, put him if we have somebody on the court who maybe isn't shooting as much threes, so put that five over there, you can put him on me.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the impact of the Utah Jazz facility
quotes.excerpt: We knew there was a need, but to see them gravitate to it so quickly, they fill the need.
quotes.quote: We knew there was a need, but to see them gravitate to it so quickly, they fill the need. It was the need was there, we were able to fill it. It's just been amazing to see how quickly we got it up and running.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the Grizzlies' playoff run
quotes.excerpt: We had a system that we were doing, we trusted each other, staff trusted us, and we played hard.
quotes.quote: We had a system that we were doing, we trusted each other, staff trusted us, and we played hard. And I think I was able to just be myself, you know, I was able to find a rhythm, find a flow.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on coaching philosophy and player roles
quotes.excerpt: He's not going to make a workhorse into a racehorse. He's not going to turn a plumber into an electrician.
quotes.quote: He's not going to make a workhorse into a racehorse. He's not going to turn a plumber into an electrician. But he's going to find a place for you to do what you do. And I think that's something that he does so special.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on Jimmy Butler's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: He just refuses to lose a lot of times and during that run where his body was great.
quotes.quote: Jimmy's a very interesting, unique individual, you know, people talk about obviously the athleticism of LeBron, but his mind is second to none. Jimmy's will, I think is really what sets him apart. He just refuses to lose a lot of times and during that run where his body was great, his mental was in a great place, obviously he was playing out of his mind. He just would turn it on and refuse to lose.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on defensive strategy and player development
quotes.excerpt: I value defense, I value not letting my man score. I seek the challenge of switching onto a bigger guy.
quotes.quote: I value defense, I value not letting my man score. I seek the challenge of switching onto a bigger guy, like I'm not running away from it. So for me, I kind of just embrace that.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the impact of trades on players
quotes.excerpt: It's definitely a shock to the system because Melo, JG, Miles, those are our guys.
quotes.quote: It's definitely a shock to the system because Melo, JG, Miles, those are our guys. We love being around those dudes, man. Anytime a teammate goes somewhere else, obviously you're happier for them because maybe it's a better situation. But I don't know, I love having those guys.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on the reality of being traded
quotes.excerpt: It's the nature of the business and we're all the reason we all play is to get better and to improve.
quotes.quote: It's the nature of the business and we're all the reason we all play is to get better and to improve and to win a championship. We trust JP in the front office to do what they got to do. Excited to have Naz, Grayson, all these guys that are joining us, like all Royse, all these guys that are joining us, we're happy to have them.
